build_assignment: build cluster assignments for a shard by computing euclidean or cosine distance to cluster centers
run_prep_inference: run the clustering evaluation script to assign image features to cluster centers across shards
func_shard_processing: process a range of shard IDs and build assignments for each shard in parallel
main_multiprocessing: orchestrate multiprocessing shard assignment by distributing shard IDs across worker threads
review_build_assignment: review the build_assignment function to understand euclidean and cosine distance computation for cluster assignment
